top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Red Sox in Thrilling Match**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 2-1 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Simeon Woods Richardson earning the win. Jameson Taillon led the pitching effort with 4.0 IP, 3 K, 0 ER, and 3 BB.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Braves in Thrilling 8-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured an 8-5 win over the Atlanta Braves, with Brett Baty leading the charge at the plate. Baty hit a home run and drove in four runs, while Brent Suter pitched 3.0 strong innings with three strikeouts and no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Orioles 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 9-5 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Josh Bell leading the Orioles' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. Dean Kremer pitched 7 strong innings for the Orioles, allowing 1 earned run and striking out 7.

top_news.title: **Phillies Edge Cardinals in Thrilling 6-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies secured a hard-fought 6-5 win over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Andrew Painter earning the win. Jonathan Bowlan closed out the game with a save.

top_news.title: **Giants C Daniel Susac Lands on 10-Day IL**
top_news.summary: San Francisco Giants catcher Daniel Susac has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left knee patella fracture.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made a move, acquiring first baseman Jacob Berry in a trade. Berry joins the Royals after being previously affiliated with the Miami Marlins.
